messages:
sara-sales: heads-up — Zephyr AI POC hitting intermittent 429s during load test. They say it ramps from 50 -> 600 req/min in bursts and then clients see throttles.

devon-se: thanks sara. any logs or headers from the SDK? 429 usually from per-route caps or token budget exhaustion.

sara-sales: pasted their client log (sanitized):
```
2026-03-20T15:12:06Z GET /v1/generate 200 latency=120ms tokens=18
2026-03-20T15:12:07Z POST /v1/generate 429 retry-after=2 route=chat-default
2026-03-20T15:12:07Z POST /v1/generate 429 reason=ROUTE_CAP_EXCEEDED
```

mike-eng: ROUTE_CAP_EXCEEDED — looks like a per-route token or concurrency guard. Is Zephyr using many short requests or large prompts?

sara-sales: many short requests, client factories spawn 20 threads each doing ~30 requests over 2s windows. Customer expects bursty traffic during live demo.

clara-sre: quick checklist:
- confirm per-route caps for their org id (sales can request temporary bump)
- check token budget per account and per-route token window
- recommend client-side smoothing + jitter/backoff

mike-eng: can reproduce locally with a simple runner. Hypothesis: combined per-route concurrent limit + token burst window causes 429s when multiple threads align.

devon-se: what do we suggest to the customer now? immediate mitigation steps they can do pre-demo.

clara-sre: short-term: add exponential backoff on 429 with randomized jitter, cap concurrency to 10 threads. Medium-term: request a soft-cap increase for their trial org for the demo window (1hr). We can also enable temporary route-level burst allowance for the trial.

sara-sales: i'll ask Zephyr to throttle client and confirm demo time. can you draft the ops request text i should send to enterprise-support? need clear numbers.

mike-eng: draft for ops ticket: "Customer org zephyr-org-12 requests trial soft-cap increase: target sustained 600 req/min for 30 minutes with peak bursts up to 900 req/min. Route: chat-default. Current observed 429 reason=ROUTE_CAP_EXCEEDED. Proposed: raise per-route concurrent cap from 50 -> 150 and token window allowance from 200k -> 500k for 1 hour. Contact: sara-sales@redwood.com"

sara-sales: perfect. i'll submit. also cc @clara-sre and @devon-se.

ops-bot: Support ticket created: INC-2026-1123 (temporary quota request). ETA for triage: ~15m. Assigned to oncall-sre.

clara-sre: once ticket is in, i'll monitor and coordinate a one-off bump. also happy to provide a short note Zephyr can add to their client config: `max_concurrency=10, retry_policy=exp_backoff(100ms, max=3)`. small change, big difference.

devon-se: for follow-up, we should add example in docs around "demo traffic patterns" and a snippet for smoothing. also mark this pattern for product to consider as a canned enterprise demo bump flow.

sara-sales: thanks all — i’ll update Zephyr and confirm after ops action. :thumbsup:
